spans.s:
उन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, wetted, wet, moist; kind, hu-
mane.

ऊन ऊन, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt. अव् and
opposed to पूर्ण, अति-रिक्त, अधिक), wanting, de-
ficient, defective, short of any quantity, less than the
right number, not sufficient; less (in number, size,
or degree), minus, fewer, smaller, inferior, &c. (e. g.
ऊन-द्विवर्ष, not quite two years old; द्वाभ्याम्
ऊन, less by two; अल्पोन, ‘less by a little,’ ‘a little
less.’ Prefixed to any even decimal numeral from
twenty up to a hundred, ऊन serves to denote one
less than the even ten, e. g. ऊन-विंशति, twenty
minus one or nineteen; ऊन-त्रिंशत्, thirty minus
one; ऊनत्रिंश, the thirtieth minus one or twenty-
ninth: so also with other numerals prefixed, e. g.
पञ्चोन-त्रिंशत्, thirty minus five or twenty-five;
एकोनचत्वारिंश, the fortieth minus one or thirty-
ninth.)

उन्नट् उन्-नट् (उद्-नट्), Caus. P. -नाटयति,
-यितुम्, to play a trick upon (with gen.).
उन्नत उन्-नत. See उन्-नम् below.

उन्-नत, अस्, आ, अम्, raised, held or lifted up;
high, tall; projecting, plump, full; great, eminent;
(अस्), m. a boa (अज-गर); N. of a Buddha; (अम्),
n. elevation, ascension.
—उन्नत-चरण, अस्, आ, अम्,
[]
with uplifted paws, rampant.
—उन्नत-त्व, अम्, n.
height, sublimity, majesty.
—उन्नत-नाभि, इस्, इस्, इ,
having a projecting navel, i. e. corpulent.
—उन्नत-
शिरस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, holding up the head, carrying the
head high; with head upraised.
—उन्नतानत (˚त-
आन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, elevated and depressed, uneven, un-
dulating, wavy.

उन्नद् उन्-नद् (उद्-नद्), cl. 1. P. -नदति,
-दितुम्, to cry out, sound, roar.
उन्-नाद, अस्, m. crying out, humming, chirping.

उन्नम् उन्-नम् (उद्-नम्), cl. 1. P. -नमति,
-नन्तुम्, to rise, ascend; to bend up, raise, elevate,
erect: Caus. P. -नमयति, -यितुम्, to bend up-
wards, raise, erect.

उन्-नति, इस्, f. elevation, height; rising, ascending;
increase, advancement, prosperity; N. of a daughter
of Dakṣa and wife of Dharma; the wife of Garuḍa.
—उन्नति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, elevated, projecting,
plump; high, sublime.
—उन्नतीश (˚ति-ईश), अस्, m.
a N. of Garuḍa.

उन्-नमन, अम्, n. bending upwards, raising,
lifting up.
उन्-नमय्य, ind. having raised.

उन्-नमित, अस्, आ, अम्, raised, elevated, lifted or
pulled up; heightened, increased.
उन्-नामित, अस्, आ, अम्, raised up.

उन्-नम्र, अस्, आ, अम्, erect, upright, elevated,
lofty, high.
—उन्नम्र-ता, f. erectness, uprightness
(of the body).

उन्-नाम, अस्, m. bending upwards, raising, lift-
ing up.
उन्नय उन्-नय. See under 1. उन्-नी below.

उन्-नय, अस्, m. raising, elevating, hoisting, lead-
ing upwards; analogy, resemblance, consequence.
उन्-नाय, अस्, m. raising, elevating.

ऊनय, nom. P. ऊनयति, -यितुम्, to leave defi-
cient or unfinished; to deduct or lessen; to mete
out in small quantities; to measure.

उन्नयनपङ्क्ति उन्-नयन-पङ्क्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, hav-
ing the line of the eyelids uplifted.

उन्नस उन्-नस (उद्-नस्), अस्, आ, अम्, having
a prominent nose.

उन्नह् उन्-नह् (उद्-नह्), cl. 4. P. -नह्यति,
-नद्धुम्, to tie up, bind up.

उन्-नद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, tied up; swelled, in-
creased; unbound.

उन्-नाह, अस्, m. sour gruel made from the fer-
mentation of rice.
उन्-नाह; add — excess; unbridled conduct.

उन्नाभ उन्-नाभ, अस्, m. (fr. उद् + नाभि),
N. of a prince.

उन्-नयन, अम्, n. raising, elevating, lifting up;
taking out of, drawing water; the vessel out of which
a fluid is taken; leading away; making straight,
smoothing; deliberation, discussion, logic, reasoning,
inference.

उन्-नायक, अस्, आ, अम्, what raises; what leads to
an inference or conclusion.
ऊनक, अस्, आ, अम्, not sufficient, less, inferior.
उन्-नहन, अस्, आ, अम्, unfettered, unrestrained.
